action: Verified from the official Cargo Build Scripts reference that target-specific config can override a build script only for a package declaring a matching links key; Cargo then skips compiling/running that build script and consumes supplied metadata instead.
tested_scope: Package manifest declares links=foo and a matching [target.<triple>.foo] Cargo config supplies replacement metadata for the active target.
scope_guard: This does not prove universal build.rs suppression, correctness of replacement metadata, or end-to-end scheduled-Chat Rust build parity.
residual_dependency: Actual Cargo/rustc execution and semantic equivalence of substituted build-script effects remain unresolved.
continuation: On the next invocation, fresh-bootstrap and freeze current authority, then inspect exactly one official Cargo documentation page or section describing package.build or build-script disabling. Determine only whether a consumer can disable build.rs for a dependency package that lacks links, without modifying that dependency's source; record exact scope and semantic limitations, and do not attempt actual Cargo execution.
